Mercury Plastics provides PFAS-free manufacturing processes in extrusions and molded components. We are one of only a few companies in North America that has captive electron beam processing; including a 5 MeV electron beam accelerator, which has been in operation since 1999, and a recently added 10 MeV electron beam accelerator. As demonstrated below, core responsibilities are grouped into three major areas of responsibility including: (1) Corporate FP&A, (2)  Trade Partnership – Builder and (3) Trade Partnership – Non-Builder.

We are looking for an individual to be a trusted business partner for our corporate Finance function and to our Trade channel stakeholders and leadership teams.  This role is provided the opportunity for ongoing review and influence on meaningful business case opportunities and programs we offer to key customers and has a direct impact on service levels to our customers, the programs we offer them and the method and pace of our growth. This position provides creative independent work and includes significant involvement within dynamic cross-functional team settings.  In order to be successful in this role, the candidate must be good at analysis, and prioritize a balance of risk mitigation and communication to Finance leadership while also building and helping to grow partnership levels between Finance and our Trade channel team members.

This will be a hybrid position in our Carmel, Indiana headquarters.

Responsibilities:
Financial Planning & Analysis
- Responsible for Trade GTN budgeting, forecasting, and analysis of costs that reduce net sales,
- Lead monthly financial meetings with the Sr. VP of Finance and Sr. Director of FP&A to report out on channel/customer sales and expenses with comparison YOY and to forecast
- Provide commentary on changes to forecast, prior year,and sales results
- Inform management of risks and opportunities to the Trade forecast
- Prepare and analyze standard monthly financial reports for Finance and other departments and develop and improve financial reporting process
- Prepare Net Sales flash forecast with FP&A team on mid-month, Day -1, and Day 1 of month end
- Collaborate with FP&A team members to maintain and improve consistencies and align strategies for multiple business channels with other FP&A team members
- Work closely with the Trade Accountant to review GTN month-end calculations including proper COPA mapping, calculate and provide assumptions for builder home closings, builder price protection claims, and WIP program reserves.
- Complete a New Construction report monthly and provide to the respective accounting team members
- Maintain a continuous improvement mindset identify and implement process improvements in reporting, transacting, and analysis processes and tools.

Trade Partnership - Builder

- Work with the Masco Legal team, as needed, to review standard contract verbiage, changes, and ad-hoc contracts to ensure the terms of the contract mitigate risk and can be processed by accounting as outlined.

- Assist in preparing and reviewing Business Case PowerPoint presentations for contract terms that meet the thresholds requiring ELT and/or Masco approvals.
- Process builder signing bonuses and account development funds within the required timeline as defined by the signed builder contract.
- Present Builder sales and expenses to Builder team each month
- Obtain insights from the Builder team on significant contract performance, including but not limited to, potential upcoming renewals, significant spend increases, significant underperformance and under utilized reserves, etc.

Trade Partnership – All Non-Builder

- Keep leadership team in Finance informed of new or changing customer programs or incentives and financial impact
- Analyze the Showroom Representative rewards programming by completing an IBNR and Spend Analysis, in addition to reviewing Showroom promotions that may impact results, and discussing in a monthly meeting.
- Complete and analyze the FEI inventory analysis report monthly.
- Support the Trade Commercial Tracker projects and Strategic Initiative through each phase; from discovery to review/approval, to identifying key metrics and measurements, to monitoring results.

We are hiring an IT Security Compliance Analyst to join our IT Team!

DISCOVER
As the Analyst, IT Security Compliance, you'll serve as a key connection point between IT Operations, Software Development, management, and the Internal Audit functions. You'll help ensure that systems, processes, and controls are implemented effectively while meeting both regulatory compliance and internal security standards. In this role, you'll work cross-functionally across Watkins Wellness and Masco, partnering with IT teams, business leaders, and audit stakeholders to coordinate reviews, maintain documentation, respond to audit requests, and support cybersecurity and compliance initiatives.

You'll balance day-to-day audit and compliance administration with opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, and identify more efficient ways of working. During your first several months, you'll focus on learning Watkins and Masco audit requirements, understanding key business processes, and building knowledge of how information is managed and secured across the organization. This position offers excellent growth potential as the organization continues to expand its security and compliance capabilities. While compliance and audit experience are essential, we are committed to helping the right candidate further develop their technical security knowledge and skills. This is a hybrid role.

YOUR RIPPLE EFFECT
- Do you enjoy being the connection point between IT, management, and audit teams? Partner with stakeholders across Watkins Wellness and Masco to coordinate audit activities, respond to compliance inquiries, communicate requirements, and ensure audit requests are addressed efficiently and accurately.
- Are you passionate about security, compliance, and strong internal controls? Conduct and administer recurring audits and control reviews, monitor compliance with established security policies and regulatory frameworks, and help maintain a strong IT security and compliance posture across the organization.
- Do you have an eye for detail when it comes to system access and administrative controls? Review employee access requests, account changes, privileged access assignments, department transfers, and deprovisioning activities to ensure appropriate controls are followed and security risks are minimized.
- Do you enjoy solving problems and driving continuous improvement? Track audit findings and remediation efforts, support corrective action plans, and identify opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen controls, and improve the effectiveness of compliance activities.
- Can you manage complex information and keep stakeholders organized? Collect, validate, and maintain audit evidence and documentation, prepare reports and responses for audit reviews, coordinate audit schedules, and ensure key information is available when needed.
- Are you interested in helping protect the organization from evolving cybersecurity risks? Support security and risk management initiatives by coordinating cybersecurity assessments and penetration testing activities, assisting with NIST/CIS evaluations, and helping ensure IT practices remain secure, compliant, and current.

WHAT YOU BRING
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field with an IT background preferred.
- 3+ years of experience in IT security, compliance, auditing, or a related field.
- Proven audit experience supporting internal, external, or regulatory audits.
- Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGCs), access management, and security best practices.
- Experience working with compliance and regulatory frameworks such as SOX, PCI, NIST, CIS, ISO, or similar standards.
- Familiarity with IT administration concepts and systems such as Active Directory or similar technologies.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with IT teams, management, auditors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and other business productivity tools.
- Experience with ServiceNow, ITIL-based processes, or related service management practices is a plus.
- CISA and/or CISSP certifications are desirable.

At Watkins Wellness, we believe that everyone should ‘Feel good. Live well’. We offer employees the opportunity to join a dynamic, growing industry leader with an outstanding and well-deserved reputation for leadership and commitment to our employees, customers and community. Our employees are eligible to receive exceptional health and wellness benefits, paid time off, company bonus, profit sharing, 401k match, education assistance, and much more. We are proud of the people we are and the products we make — products that make a difference to the health and well-being of others.
